Germany news: Deportations on the decline
November 5, 2026
Despite a decrease in overall deportations, more people were sent back to Turkey than in previous years. At the same time, Volkswagen is facing a fresh 'Dieselgate' trial. DW has more.
What you need to know
- Official numbers show a strong decline in deportations in 2026 compared to last year.
- More than ten years after the 'Dieselgate' scandal, a new trial is set to begin against former Volkswagen executives
Here are the latest headlines from across Germany on Thursday, November 5:
Overall deportations down, but returns to Turkey on the rise
The number of people deported from Germany decreased by nearly 19% from January to September 2026 compared to the previous year, the Interior Ministry announced following a request from the Left Party.
Some 14,324 people were deported in the first nine months of this year, down from 17,651 in 2025. Turkey was the most common destination, followed by Georgia and Algeria.
The numbers reveal that deportations to Syria remain difficult due to the political situation there, even for convicted criminals. Six people have been returned there since the beginning of 2026.
Deportations to Turkey, however, appeared to buck the trend, as 2,025 people have been sent there.
According to the Interior Ministry, the number of foreign nationals leaving the country voluntarily has also slightly increased. Some 14,140 people have received assistance to return to their countries of origin, compared to 12,263 the year before.
Welcome to our coverage
Good morning from a crisp and autumnal Bonn.
Today we will be bringing you stories about a decline in deportations, corporate scandal and whether Germans will be able to learn to swim and drive — and how much it might cost.
Stay tuned!

משרד הפנים בגרמניה דיווח על ירידה של כמעט 19 אחוזים במספר בני האדם שגורשו מהמדינה בין חודשים ינואר לספטמבר 2026, בהשוואה לתקופה המקבילה אשתקד. בסך הכל גורשו 14,324 בני אדם, כאשר היעד המרכזי היה טורקיה, ואחריה גאורגיה ואלג'יריה. למרות המגמה הכללית, מספר המורחקים לטורקיה דווקא רשם עלייה והגיע ל-2,025 בני אדם.

במקביל לנתוני הגירוש, נרשמה עלייה קלה במספר האזרחים הזרים שבחרו לעזוב את גרמניה מרצון בסיוע הרשויות. נתונים אלו מתפרסמים בעוד קונצרן הרכב פולקסווגן מתמודד עם משפט חדש בפרשת הדיזלגייט, יותר מעשור לאחר פרוץ השערורייה המקורית.
